sections.label: Traineeship and attachment opportunities
sections.summary: Over 20,500 traineeship and attachment opportunities are available, over 2,800 local jobseekers placed, and SBF's team of 25 will be full strength by end-October.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: By now, over 20,500 traineeship and company attachment opportunities have been made available.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: More than 2,800 local jobseekers have been placed.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The SBF has a dedicated team of 25, of which 80% are filled and will be reaching full strength by end-October.

sections.label: SGUnited Jobs and Skills placements
sections.summary: Since the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package launched in April 2020, 33,100 jobseekers have been placed into job, traineeship, attachment and training opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Since the launch of the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package in April 2020, we have placed 33,100 jobseekers into job, traineeship, attachment and training opportunities.

sections.label: Curated opportunities and placements
sections.summary: About 117,500 opportunities have been curated, and around 33,000 have been placed.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Today, if you look at the overall opportunities that have been curated, there are about 117,500.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We have been able to place 33,000 or so.

sections.label: Jobs Growth incentive for employers
sections.summary: The Jobs Growth incentive encourages employers to expand hiring, and wage support may let them bring forward hiring.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Some of the ways in which the Government is trying to be helpful and to nudge the employers in this direction is through the introduction of the Jobs Growth incentive.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: This Jobs Growth incentive, essentially, encourages employers to expand their hiring and if the wage support that is provided is able to provide that additional resourcing to the employers, they could also bring forward their hiring.

sections.label: Opportunities for non-PMETs
sections.summary: Of about 117,000 curated opportunities, 70% are jobs of different nature, some suitable for PMETs and some for non-PMETs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Is there another channel that non PMETs, and specifically unskilled jobseekers, should approach instead?

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: I mentioned earlier that total opportunities that have been curated under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package is about 117,000.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Of these, 70% are jobs and the jobs are of different nature – some are long-term jobs, some are short-term jobs; some of these jobs are suitable for PMETs, some of these jobs are suitable for non PMETs.

sections.label: Jobs matched for PMETs
sections.summary: The Member is incorrect to think that most of the jobs matched are for PMETs.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The Member is incorrect to think that most of the jobs that have been matched are for PMETs.
